text:
By Esther Marshall
Published: 07:26 GMT, February 9, 2025 | Updated: 07:26 GMT, February 9, 2025
Advertisement
Bognor Regis is one of the best known coastal cities in the United Kingdom today, but life began as a small fishing village.
He was a 18th -century merchant named Sir Richard Hotham who saw the potential of the West Sussex village as a coastal complex. He bought land and created a hotel and an entertainment building, with the first ‘season’ of the resort in 1791.
The popularity of the city shot at the end of the 19th century after a railway station was built in 1864 that caused the coastal access point to be much more accessible.
Bognor had to consolidate his place even more firmly on the map when King George v He stayed there in 1929. This visit led to the addition of ‘Regis’ to the name of the city, after a request was made to the monarch.
Although Bognor Regis has fallen from those real heights and was one of the most qualified coastal cities in What is the 2024 ranking of the United Kingdom coastal resorts It is still a popular holiday place for British stays.
Take a look at Bognor Regis with this collection of historical photos, from bathing machines to hunting the most glamorous grandmother …
In the photo above is Bognor Parade in 1882. The city railway station had opened in 1864, making the city more accessible to the broader public. Bognor Regis Pier, which can be seen to the left of the photo, was inaugurated in 1865. THE BOGNOR MIER FIDICS He says that at that time people were charged a small rate to walk at length
The Bognor Regis Navy is shown here around 1900. The royal hotel seen to the right of the image has now become floors
The esplanade in Bognor Regis is shown here in 1895. Gadgets with wheels on the beach are bath machines, which were used to protect the modesty of people while swimming in the sea
Tourists are shown here in Bognor Regis Beach in early 1900. Bognor Regis obtained his first cinema, a theater and a roller skating track at this time, he explains localhistories.org
This image shows children in Bognor Regis Beach in 1920. This was a moment of growing enthusiasm for coastal holidays. The Victoria & Albert Museum He explains: “Take the sun (was) encouraged, and a Sunta became a fashion sign of wealth and leisure”
The crowds are photographed on the beach and the walk in 1929. This was the year that King Jorge V stayed in the city to recover from a serious illness, he explains Love Bognor Regis . After his stay, the king received the request to add regis to the name of the city, a request that was granted
Three tourists are shown on the beach of Bognor Regis in 1950. Historical England He explains that “the great British coast reached its peak in the postwar years”
In this image, taken in 1956, Perspex windshields are placed in the Bognor Regis sailor as part of an experiment to “protect tourists from the sea breeze”
Children are shown in this 1959 image that enjoys donkey walks on Bognor Regis beach
Left: In this humorous image, taken in 1960, tourists in Bognor Regis Beach laugh when a tourist’s lid collapses under his weight. Right: This 1960 image represents two contestants in a Bognor Marilyn Monroe Lookalike competition
In this image, a hopeful competitor who tries to fly in the Bognor Regis International Birdman contest in 1979 is shown in 1979. The contestants would compete to see who could fly through the air farther after jumping from the end of the dock
A contestant in the 1979 Birdman contest tries to fly while he was dressed like a bird. Sir Richard Branson participated in the 2003 competition before he finished forever in 2016
